rows.title: Open Era
notes: “it started off with Open Air off of his new album, Pleas, that just came out last week”
Track on DJ Plead's album 'Please' (Smalltown Supersound); presenter's "Open Air"/"Pleas" are near-homophones for "Open Era"/"Please".

rows.title: I Used To Feel Quite Sad At Outdoor Raves
Habibi Da
notes: “and then we had New Too Late song Habibi Da live album that just came out pretty recently”

rows.title: Souvenir
notes: Tunisian jazz-fusion duo (Nidhal Jaoua, Slim Abida); 'Souvenir' is a track on their album 'Lamma' (2016/2018, Shouka).

rows.title: Hamadi
notes: “before that we had Abdul Kabir Mershan with Hamadi”

rows.artist: Idris Muhammad, George Coleman, Pharoah Sanders
rows.title: Kabsha
notes: “this one behind us right now, Copsha by Idris Muhammad, George Coleman, and Farrah Sanders”
1980 Idris Muhammad album on Theresa Records, title track 'Kabsha', featuring George Coleman and Pharoah Sanders on tenor sax.

rows.title: The Road of El Jadida
notes: “This one is Otman El Kaloudi with The Road of El Jadida and El Jadida ... well this one Otman El Kaloudi will leave you with this”
Moroccan 'neo-beldi' composer/saxophonist; track from the album 'Zid Zid (When Light Takes You on Its Motorbike)' (2019); matches presenter's repeated 'El Jadida'.

rows.artist: Anouar Brahem, Anja Lechner, Django Bates & Dave Holland
rows.title: After the Last Sky
Anna's Organ
notes: “And then Jeremiah Chu, Marta Sophia Horner with Anas Orgin”
the audio briefly looked like Perturbator Feat. Tommy - Perverted Precnict, but the presenter said otherwise
Track 9 on 'Recordings from the Åland Islands' (2022, International Anthem); "Anas Orgin" is an ASR mishearing of "Anna's Organ".

rows.title: Helia - A COLORS SHOW (feat. Sven Wunder)
The Forgotten Path to Humanity
notes: “joseph tordros forgotten path of humanity local hero local hero unisw honorary doctorate receive recipient”
Sydney-raised oud virtuoso's 2025 release; received an honorary UNSW Doctorate of Music in Dec 2025, matching the presenter's "local hero" / UNSW reference.

rows.artist: Gary Bartz, Adrian Younge & Ali Shaheed Muhammad
rows.title: Spiritual Ideation
Baka Dom
notes: “we had Baka Dom with Anthony Kalanico”
mentioned by the presenter but we couldn't work out when it played
Bongo-laced ambient jazz track on 'Spacious Heart' (2026, Music From Memory), the LA musician's solo debut.
